messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-5155 fired for service hosted-inference-prod — symptom: elevated 5xx errors and GPU OOM on inference-worker. Trigger rule: error-rate > 1% for 3m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-5155

pagerduty-bot: Auto-escalation: Primary (Maya Patel) did not acknowledge within 3m. Paging secondary: Kevin Ortiz. Manager escalation scheduled at +7m if not acknowledged. Calling primary device...

Maya Patel: I'm on the commute and my phone is in a bag, sorry about that. Trying to acknowledge now.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement overdue -> Manager escalation: paging Liz Park now (call +1-555-0159).

Kevin Ortiz: ack

Kevin Ortiz: quick check — grepping logs shows repeated "cudaOutOfMemory" from pod inference-worker-5 in us-central. CPU fine but memory balloon on model shard loader. Logs: https://kibana.example/app/discover#/_g=(filters:!())&_a=(query:(query_string:(query:'service:inference-worker AND message:"cudaOutOfMemory"')))

SRE Oncall: joining bridge -> https://meet.example/bridge/INC-5155 (me: jon.chen). Opening SEV2 bridge.

Jon Chen: created incident channel thread and SEV2 bridge, added eng-runtime and eng-ml.

Olivia S: customer-facing: 503s ~1.8% in US since 14:22. Affected: BetaTenant (real-time embedding calls). Logged SUP-8331, I put preliminary note: "Investigating degraded embeddings performance; mitigation in progress."

Liz Park: manager ping: if primary and secondary are delayed, I'll take escalation — on my way. Any mitigation options without code rollback?

Kevin Ortiz: mitigation options: 1) scale worker pool to absorb OOM churn; 2) revert to previous model artifact (v1.14) — recent rollout v1.15 shows memory regression; 3) drain offending node. My vote: rollback + scale.

Kevin Ortiz: running commands now:
```
# scale workers in us-central
redwood infra scale workers --region=us-central --replicas=12
# cordon and drain node with repeated OOMs
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 && kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

incident-bot: PD note: "Secondary Kevin Ortiz initiated scale and node drain at 14:25 UTC. Possible regression from model v1.15 rollout."

Maya Patel: ack-ed via mobile at 14:26 — apologizing for the delay. I've already paused the v1.15 rollout in rollout-manager.

Kevin Ortiz: initiating rollback to v1.14:
```
redwood models rollback hosted-inference-prod --model=embedding-model --version=v1.14 --confirm
```

Jon Chen: bridge logs show pods restarting healthy after rollback. Monitoring metrics.

Olivia S: 5xx rate trending down to 0.4% at 14:33. Customer impact notice updated: "Mitigation applied, monitoring for 30m, follow-up postmortem pending."

Liz Park: good. Keep bridge open. Assign owners: Kevin -> infra follow-up (investigate v1.15 memory footprint), Olivia -> customer comms and support liaison, Maya -> rollout gating and CI mem tests. I'll own management follow-up and any escalations to account teams.

Kevin Ortiz: follow-up checklist posted to incident doc, creating infra ticket INF-2427 for autoscaler tuning and model memory tests. Also adding alert for model rollout-increase of memory usage.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-5155 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. Auto-resolve scheduled in 30m if no regressions. PD note appended: "Rollback to v1.14 and node drain mitigated increased OOMs; monitoring."

incident-bot: Closing notes: bridge will remain open for 30 minutes observation. Please add RCA items to the incident doc and include heap/memory comparisons between v1.14 and v1.15.

(+:thumbsup: by Liz Park)
(+:white_check_mark: by Kevin Ortiz)
